== Production ==
On March 13, 2026, Peacock renewed ''Love Island: USA'' for season eight with a premiere date of June 2, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2026-03-13 |title='Love Island USA' Renewed for Season 8, Sets June Premiere|url=https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/love-island-usa-renewed-season-8-premiere-june-1236687237/|access-date=2026-05-09 |website=Variety|language=en-US}}</ref> [[Ariana Madix]] returned as host for her third season with [[Iain Stirling]] once again providing narration.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2026-04-26 |title='Love Island USA's Ariana Madix On Her Evolution As Host & What She’s Looking Forward To In Season 8 – Contenders TV|url=https://deadline.com/2026/04/love-island-usa-ariana-madix-interview-season-8-1236872907/|access-date=2026-05-09 |website=Deadline|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2026-04-26 |title=Everything to Know About 'Love Island USA' Season 8, From the Release Schedule to a Rumored Islander|url=https://www.marieclaire.com/culture/tv-shows/love-island-usa-season-8/|access-date=2026-05-09 |website=Marie Claire|language=en-US}}</ref> On May 9, 2026, it was announced that [[Maura Higgins]] would not return to the series to host ''Love Island: Aftersun'' this season.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2026-04-26 |title='Love Island' Fan-Favorite Is Saying Goodbye to the Franchise After 7 Years|url=https://parade.com/tv/love-island-fan-favorite-is-saying-goodbye-to-the-franchise-after-7-years|access-date=2026-05-09 |website=Parade|language=en-US}}</ref> On May 11, 2026, it was announced that ''[[Summer House (2017 TV series)|Summer House]]'' star [[Ciara Miller]] and [[Tefi Pessoa]] would be co-hosting ''Aftersun'' this season. <ref>{{Cite web |last=Tinoco |first=Armando |date=2026-05-11 |title='Summer House's Ciara Miller Joins 'Love Island USA' As 'Aftersun' Co-Host Alongside Teffi Pessoa |url=https://deadline.com/2026/05/summer-house-ciara-miller-host-love-island-usa-aftersun-1236889090/ |access-date=2026-05-11 |website=Deadline |language=en-US}}</ref> On July 12, 2026, it was announced that there would be a reunion to air on August 31, 2026 on Peacock hosted by Ariana Madix and [[Andy Cohen]].
